name: Local Hull-Based Surface Construction
aliases: Local convex classification and 3D hull based surface generation
definition: A surface construction algorithm that copes with concavity by classifying local convexities from an imperfect MC surface and estimating each local hull using the 3D hull algorithm, then combining locally constructed surfaces.
summary: Local Hull-Based Surface Construction extracts concave surfaces by classifying local convexities from an initial Marching Cubes mesh and applying 3D hull algorithms to preserve features standard methods flatten.
